title: Filtered Long-Code Optimum
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number, let an encoded regular Unique Games family with alphabet size $q$ be given, and let a finite long-code test boundary for a sign tester with alphabet size $q$ be given. For a semantic instance, a uniform refinement of its allowed long-code weighted experiment, and natural numbers $r,M$ with $r\le M$, assume every tester check has arity at most $r$. The filtered long-code optimum is the rational optimum of the globally filtered long-code constraint satisfaction problem formed from these data.
